initial_generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one polished game art direction sheet showing ten distinct model concepts for Crownroad, a medieval fantasy caravan siege game.
Primary request: Create ONE beautiful landscape image containing exactly TEN game asset examples in a clean five-column by two-row grid. The user's intended style is nicely detailed and more cartoony, but only moderately cartoony: convincing premium stylized 3D game models with excellent material detail and readable silhouettes.

Composition: landscape canvas, all ten equal-sized cells fully visible, consistent margins and generous breathing room. Fine subtle dividers, very light warm-gray studio background, soft contact shadows underneath each asset. Small refined header reading "CROWNROAD — MODEL CONCEPTS". Each cell contains one isolated complete model, centered, with a clearly readable small numbered name and category beneath it. All character feet, heads, weapons and all structure edges must stay inside their own cells. No asset crosses a divider. No inset pictures, no supplementary sketches, no scenic backgrounds. Render each model large enough to appreciate details. Three-quarter front orthographic view, camera slightly elevated; architecture uses matching three-quarter isometric presentation. Environment pieces can use their own scale to fill their cell.

Exact cell contents in reading order, five across each row:
01 "SHIELD KNIGHT" / "ALLY": sturdy human knight, broad blue-black iron plate armor with finely beveled edges, teal cloth tabard, brass fittings, large shield with understated royal lantern heraldry and a practical sword. Quietly heroic, head visible or open visor. Approximately six heads tall, grounded anatomy.
02 "ARCHER" / "ALLY": lean human archer with expressive adult face, hood pushed back, teal layered traveling cloth, quilted leather jerkin, leather bracers, curved wood bow, quiver and practical belt pouches. A ready but relaxed pose with the bow easy to read.
03 "MAGE" / "ALLY": adult field mage in layered teal and warm neutral robes, leather belt, brass rune fittings, wooden staff with a small amber crystal lantern, restrained warm magic. Clear fabric folds, mature facial features, practical traveling outfit.
04 "LANTERN GUARD" / "ALLY": robust veteran guard wearing a steel helmet and heavy iron armor with teal accents, wielding a long polearm with an amber lantern mounted near the blade, travel-worn cloak and sculpted brass trim. Distinct silhouette from the Shield Knight.
05 "RISEN" / "ENEMY": undead foot soldier, a stylized expressive skull with sensible human proportions, mismatched weathered iron armor, faded crimson cloth, old chipped sword and ruined heraldry. Readable and sinister with a restrained ghostly eye glow.
06 "BLIGHT CASTER" / "ENEMY": gaunt undead spellcaster wearing ragged burgundy robes and bone charms, plague staff with a small sickly green brazier, quiet smoky green magic. Detailed cloth and carved staff, a strongly readable character, no gore.
07 "GRAVE BRUTE" / "ENEMY": imposing broad undead warrior, asymmetrical bone and battered dark iron armor, ruined crimson sash, massive slab-headed mace, skull face with subtle eerie glow. Thick purposeful anatomy, stylized heavy proportions, a different silhouette from the Risen.
08 "LANTERN WAR WAGON" / "ENVIRONMENT": an entire armored medieval caravan wagon, chunky oak beams with controlled directional grain, iron plates and rivets, antique brass fittings, teal canvas canopy, four big wooden wheels, attached warm amber lanterns, a modest roof-mounted ballista. Beautifully assembled believable game prop; no horses or people.
09 "RUINED GATEHOUSE" / "ENVIRONMENT": a compact modular medieval gatehouse model with an arched timber gate, blocky cut-stone walls, two short crenellated towers, chipped masonry edges, a few vines and faded crimson banner. Complete isolated architectural asset on a small stone footprint.
10 "ROADSIDE SHRINE" / "ENVIRONMENT": a small isolated environment prop combining a moss-touched carved stone lantern shrine, warm amber lamp, tiny hanging teal pennant, a cluster of irregular stones and low grass on a compact ground patch. Polished model with readable stone planes and restrained botanical detail.

Style and materials: high-quality stylized 3D rendering with hand-painted texture sensibility; charming bold shape design and slightly larger hands and equipment, adult proportions, clean sculpted forms, selective edge wear, satin iron highlights, woven cloth, aged brass, warm wood, softly mottled bone, softly chipped stone. Detailed without microscopic noise. These should feel practical to recreate as actual real-time game models. Moderate cartoon stylization, about halfway between realism and exaggerated cartoon; coherent visual language across allies, enemies and environments.
Lighting: broad warm-neutral key from upper left, cool gentle fill, soft shadows, restrained ambient occlusion, subtle rim separation. Clear color and form in every cell. No photographic grime, toy-plastic sheen, glossy chrome, enormous heads, chibi anatomy, flat vector art, pixel art, thick black outlines or painterly background scenes.
Constraints: exactly ten cells and exactly the ten requested subjects. Number and label every cell accurately. Full bodies and complete structures, no cropping, no repeated subjects, no watermark. Keep typography subordinate to the models. This is a single cohesive visual style exploration board, not an animation atlas.
final_style_edit_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Input image: the attached Crownroad ten-cell model concept grid is the EDIT TARGET.
Primary request: Keep this exact beautifully organized five-column, two-row grid and the same ten asset designs, but give the models a slightly more cartoony, appealing stylized 3D game art treatment. The current rendering reads a little too realistic. Move it a moderate step toward bold sculpted shapes and hand-painted game materials while retaining substantial detail and believable adult characters.

Change only the visual stylization of the ten models:
- Give the human characters modestly larger heads (roughly five-and-a-half to six heads tall), more expressive simplified adult faces, slightly broader hands and boots, beautifully designed chunky armor forms and clean readable silhouettes. Keep mature features and grounded poses. Avoid cute baby faces and chibi bodies.
- Simplify fine material noise and scratch density, retaining sculpted seams, bevels, useful rivets, brass ornaments, layered cloth, buckles and purposeful wear. Broad soft highlights, slightly softer rounded edges, hand-painted tonal gradients, polished stylized 3D game rendering.
- Make the undead skulls and armor a little more expressive and sculpted, with bold readable forms, preserving their menacing character and distinct builds.
- Give wagon, stone gatehouse and shrine slightly chunkier designed geometry and larger readable stone/wood details, subtly simplified surface texture, clean stylized foliage.
- Maintain the rich teal, warm oak, satin iron, antique brass, amber lanterns, bone and burgundy palette. Preserve the same attractive light and high level of craft.

Invariants: exactly the same ten assets and cell locations, identical readable numbering and names and categories, identical landscape layout, header and quiet studio background. The ten names in reading order are SHIELD KNIGHT, ARCHER, MAGE, LANTERN GUARD, RISEN, BLIGHT CASTER, GRAVE BRUTE, LANTERN WAR WAGON, RUINED GATEHOUSE, ROADSIDE SHRINE. Preserve all equipment and the overall designs. All assets must remain complete and within their cells; lower the Lantern Guard's polearm very slightly so its tip is inside the cell underneath the header. Keep everything neatly framed, no clipping or overlaps.
Aim: professional moderately cartoony game model concepts with plenty of material and construction detail. Not photorealistic, not plastic toys, not flat illustration, no thick outlines, no pixel art, no extreme caricature.
note: Visual concepts for model art direction.
